notes.title: Demo patch update v0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hey Castaways, 


Thank you to everyone who has played the Demo already, it’s been such a joy reading your comments and hearing about your favourite parts of the demo, like stacking yuzu on your head!



We are at the halfway point for the public Demo, and we're a week away from Gamescom. We've made a couple of quality-of-life updates thanks to your feedback, so please read below for all the details.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/57f0a069d6bf56957507dcd5d49d186d838376a7.gif"]



Here are the details of the patch update. 


🐛Bugfixes:
Fixed a bug where Capy could infinitely duplicate a stick.

Mac no longer hangs when restarting the game (doesn’t restart yet, but at least it won’t crash!)

Removed a textbox that appears when the game first fades in.

Fixed items sometimes flickering when getting picked up.

Fixed an error that happened when trying to wear an item immediately after grabbing it.

Non-US keyboards now display prompts in the correct language, show sprites for input prompts.

Hats now scale correctly after respawning (no more weird stacking sizes).

Reduced shakiness on the UI and pause screens.


📋Performance
Major performance improvements! Game should run smoother and at a higher framerate.

Added quality and resolution sliders to the pause menu, adjust them to your needs.

Trees and bushes fade between LODs better for smoother performance.



If you like to report a bug in-game, when you're in the pause menu, you can select Bug Reporter. Additionally, we are still collecting player feedback, which you can share  here  or on our Discord server! Once again, thank you so much to everyone for playing our first public Demo, we can't wait for you to play the rest of the game!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/c23749767e94f63b5f698aa3fad61e00be278193.png"]

notes.title: Demo patch update v0.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey Castaways, 


Thank you so much to everyone who has already played the Demo! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/93c6982b636643445c7c7e56982c203ce57abc51.gif"]

Here's the first update to the public demo


🐛Bugfixes:
The game will no longer save Unity logs to a folder on your desktop 😅

Input prompts should refer to the correct keys for AZERTY, Colemac and other Latin character layouts


📋Changes:
a toggle/ checkbox for post-processing in the pause menu

adjusted invisible walls and added a trigger that returns capy to the island

adjusted end-of-demo-popup text to clarify that you can continue playing



If you like to report a bug in-game, when you're in the pause menu, you can select Bug Reporter. Additionally, we are collecting player feedback, which you can share here or on our Discord server!
